market_summary: London morning session exhibits broad consolidation across major assets. XAUUSD is pressing session lows under descending VWAP/EMA50 but lacks immediate breakout RVOL. EURUSD and GBPUSD are trapped within their respective Value Areas with diverging CVD signals. US100 and BTCUSD remain stuck in contracted ranges around POC/VWAP, offering no clear high-confluence expansion setups.

signals.rationale: VP context shows price below VAL (3970.22) and POC (3978.89), signaling downward expansion. CVD is BEARISH (-2.67, slope -0.87) in alignment with trend. In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading firmly below VWAP (3978.35) and EMA50 (3982.19). ATR bands are expanding with price testing the lower ATR band (3955.27). RVOL is moderate at 0.917 but price is pressing directly into Session Low support at 3954.71; Selling into immediate major support without an upside pullback or RVOL breakout creates poor edge, warranting a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below VAL testing Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10701 to VAH 1.10929) and above POC (1.10757). CVD is NEUTRAL (+1,297) but cvd_slope is accelerating bullish (+2,941.69). Active in LONDON_SESSION, price has reclaimed both VWAP (1.10831) and EMA50 (1.10867). Price is pushing into the upper ATR envelope (1.10922) nearing Session High resistance at 1.10988, without an RVOL > 2.0 spike (RVOL 1.69). Since price is still contained inside the session value area approaching resistance, HOLD is favored.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32525 to VAH 1.32729) and above POC (1.32577). CVD is BEARISH (-2,427) showing divergence against recent upward push. During LONDON_SESSION, price is trapped between VWAP (1.32648) and EMA50 (1.32688), right near S/R level 1.32661. Mid-channel ATR positioning and conflicting delta without an RVOL breakout signal compression/range behavior inside value. Recommending HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral oscillating around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 28063.00 to VAH 28171.42) right near session POC (28112.50). CVD is BEARISH (-2.48) with slightly positive short-term slope (+0.80). LONDON_SESSION context shows price oscillating under EMA50 (28169.32) and hovering around VWAP (28127.64). ATR is contracting mid-channel. Per US100 tick volume dynamics, there is no structural displacement or breakout from key S/R (28083.64 / Session Low 28030.00). Strict mean-reversion chop inside VA mandates HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 73427.34 to VAH 73770.06) below POC (73549.74). CVD is BEARISH (-0.03) with flat slope. In LONDON_SESSION, price remains capped beneath declining VWAP (73651.82) and EMA50 (73716.49). RVOL is low at 0.673 with no volume spikes. ATR is contracting with price sitting mid-channel above support at 73386.80 and Session Low 73313.10. Lack of breakdown volume and proximity to nearby support dictate a HOLD.
